posts.text:
In the US, the iPhone Duo costs $1999. Based on the exchange rate, that should be $2760 CAD.

But Apple is charging $2999 CAD in Canada, meaning Canadians are paying almost 10% more than Americans for the folding iPhone.

That comes just after it changed the name of Lake Ontario on Apple Maps.
